messages:
jordan: Heads-up: PM just approved sunsetting the `model-alpha` alias (used by several starter templates). We need a concise migration note + updated SDK snippets because `input` param is being renamed to `prompt` in the new client. Goal: ship docs + sample-app updates by EOW.

priya: Ugh, the param rename will break a lot of small repos. Suggest we include a tiny compatibility helper and a one-liner in the migration guide showing how to map `input` -> `prompt`.

nate: Agree. I'll prepare code fixes for the python and node sample-apps. For node streaming we should show old vs new usage and a helper that accepts either param.

rachel: Also confirm whether `model-alpha` pointed to multiple internal variants (cpu/quantized). If so we need to call out explicit model names for those flows. I can query model catalog.

infra-bot: model-catalog: alias `model-alpha` -> ["rw-instruct-v2", "rw-instruct-v2-q4"], created: 2024-06-12

priya: Perfect. So migration doc should include a table: alias -> recommended primary model -> quantized equivalent. And a short note: "If you relied on alias auto-selection for quantized variants, pin the q4 suffix explicitly."

jordan: Draft plan: 1) short migration page with mapping table and param-rename note. 2) 4 sample edits (node sync, node streaming, python, curl). 3) add compatibility snippet helpers. 4) small changelog entry + 301 redirect from old alias doc. 5) rollback play (recreate alias for 48h if needed).

nate: Node helper suggestion (to include in doc):
```js
function normalizeReq(body) {
  // accept legacy `input` or new `prompt`
  const prompt = body.prompt ?? body.input;
  return { ...body, prompt };
}
```
Use this when wiring sample-app endpoints.

priya: For the SDK rename, include both examples in the same code block labeled "Before" and "After" so folks can grep easily. Eg:
```js
// before
await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'model-alpha', input: 'Summarize this.' });
// after
await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'rw-instruct-v2', prompt: 'Summarize this.' });
```

rachel: Small ops ask: will kv-cache behavior change between rw-instruct-v2 and rw-instruct-v2-q4? If yes, note in the doc.

infra-bot: KV cache: no semantic change; q4 variants may use slightly different memory layout. Recommend re-running cache performance tests.

jordan: Add a short QA checklist in the PR description: run sample-app integration tests, smoke streaming for latency, validate curl examples, check redirects.

priya: Pushed WIP branch: https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/910 (includes mapping table, helper snippets, and sample diff). Please review.

nate: I'll land the sample-app changes after docs review. Quick question: do we want a temporary banner on the docs page warning about rename?

rachel: Yes — a small banner for two weeks is helpful. infra: can you implement a docs banner flag?

infra-bot: Banner flag created: docs.banner: {"model-alpha-deprecation": true, "expires": "2026-04-15"}

jordan: Good. Also add a note in the changelog: short sentence + link to migration doc. Keep it user-facing and non-technical.

priya: I'll update the changelog and the migration doc with step-by-step: grep for `model-alpha`, replace with target model, and search for `input:` usages.

nate: Minor nit — for curl examples use the v2 endpoint param name `prompt` and include an example for heartbeat testing. Eg:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/chat --data '{"model":"rw-instruct-v2","prompt":"ping"}'
```

rachel: I'll add a short paragraph on rollout strategy: map weights from alias to explicit versions and show a simple weight table example.

jordan: Timeline: review today, merge docs PR by tomorrow morning, coordinate sample-app PRs to land before EOW. If any regressions, rollback plan is to reinstate alias for 48 hours and flip banner to "deprecated but active" while we hotfix.

priya: Sounds good. I'll mark owners on the PR and request reviews from @nate and @rachel.

nate: I'll review now.

jordan: Thanks everyone. Keep comments short in the PR. :rocket:
